data.body: **P2: Consume the sampling bridge before `onStart` processors run.** `SpanBuilder.startSpan()` invokes `SpanProcessor.onStart` synchronously. Because the thread-scoped override remains set throughout this call, a processor reacting to `DurableExecutionRoot` and starting an unrelated span can incorrectly apply the execution's sampling decision. Make the cross-classloader property one-shot by clearing it when `DurableSampler` resolves this span's intent, and add an `onStart` callback regression test analogous to the existing `onEnd` test.
